title: St Peter's Ilmer Burial Register
description: Burials transcribed from 'The Registers and Records of St Peter's Ilmer' (Rex A Kidd, 1982), covering 1602-1981. Extracted automatically from the digitised PDF; free-text fields preserve the original transcription including uncertain readings.

year.description: Year of burial; null only if illegible in the source

date.description: Day and month, e.g. '4 Jul'; may be incomplete for a small number of entries

forename.description: May be empty where illegible or not transcribed

surname.description: May be empty where illegible or not transcribed

age.description: Age at death, e.g. '74', '7 months', or a compound reading such as '4 weeks & 5 days' or '9 years & 1 quarter'; only recorded from the early 19th century onward, so empty for most earlier entries. A handful of entries have the register's own 'no age' in place of a value, recorded here as 'no age' rather than being left empty like an entry that simply predates age being recorded at all

notes.description: Free text following the name and age: relation (e.g. 'wife of Thomas'), address, or register annotations
